lines: This having bound in sky movement would be thus in venerable Pūrva-śāsana; sound-light-wind-joined mind having rested and above.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etāṃ baddhvā khe gatiḥ syāditi śrīpūrvaśāsane dhvanijyotirmarudyuktaṃ cittaṃ viśramya copari
